column1: # Tolbi, after Ash Jenna: Mia admits that Ash Jenna's taunts unsettled her.

column3: Mia, what she said back\nthere... she was trying to\nget under your skin.{end_wait}
I know. And I let her. I\nwon't pretend it didn't\nhurt to hear those words.{end_wait}
You don't have to face\nher alone. Whatever she\nsays, we're here.{end_wait}

Thank you, Isaac. I'm not
as untouched by this as I
would like to be, but I
won't let her define me.{end_wait}
